title: OpenCampus · UO Eugene
description: Explore UO with modular photo-informed architecture and aerial-guided landscaping.
source_description: Oregon DOGAMI / NOAA Digital Coast. Historical survey: 2008-08-31. Nine source tiles cover the main campus and surrounding context.
about_summary: The Knight Library-EMU-Johnson Hall area combines modular photo-informed facades, roofs, entrances and terraces with 300 stylized trees guided by USDA NAIP imagery captured on June 8, 2024. The surrounding campus remains a historical whitebox.
about_limitations: This is a recognizable first-pass art model, refined through long-term correction. Facade dimensions, hidden sides, roof details and tree heights/species include plausible inference. The aerial image guides illustrative canopy distribution, not surveyed individual trees. Photos span different years; EMU combines historical and later design motifs. No new field measurements or photogrammetric solve were performed. Base terrain/roof candidates retain 2008 provenance; Census roads have estimated widths. Stairs, terraces and planting are decorative, not a surveyed navigation mesh. The square extent is not a property boundary.

project_description: Open Campus: UO develops this campus model and viewer. Its public upstream pipeline develops reusable reconstruction methods, automation and the browser template. Additional maps can build on the same template.
footer: Independent reconstruction project. No University of Oregon endorsement. Public development preview.
